Container.Name: tunnelbunny
Container.Overview: Diagnostics container for VPN networks. Answers three questions from the network it sits on: is traffic in the tunnel, is DNS leaking, how fast is it. Click WebUI for the page, or Console and run: check (vpn|dns|speed|all). Also ships curl, dig, mtr, ping and Ookla speedtest.

Config.Name: VPN provider
Config.Description: Regex matched against the ASN/org field. Normally set from the web UI, which ships a list of common providers. Several have more than one company name - Mullvad is 31173 Services, NordVPN is Tefincom or PacketHub.
